name: CaseAntdComponentScopedCustomProperty
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-component-scoped-custom-property" (tokens). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: .cf-root { --cf-scoped-pad: 15px } .cf-root .cf-a { padding-inline: var(--cf-scoped-pad) } — a token DECLARED ON THE COMPONENT ROOT (not :root) and consumed by a descendant (antd cssVar component tokens on `.antd.ant-btn`)
